notes: Employees: the year-end team at March 31, 2026 from Note 17; the same note gives an average weekly staff number of 27,392 for the year. Payroll: Note 17's aggregate payroll costs (€1,856.5m: staff and related costs, social welfare, other pension and share-based payments), which equals the income statement's 'Staff costs'. It excludes staff costs capitalized into assets. Ryanair is a foreign private issuer and has no CEO pay ratio.
